leadText:
----

 
(Japanese: 秋葉原博士 Chōta) is a character of the day who appeared in the worldwide banned episode AG101 (unaired).

 and arrived on Jojo Island and helped Chōta, a local Trainer, battle several who were causing tremors across Jojo Island.
